# USAGov

> > The official guide to government information and services, connecting Americans to federal, state, and local resources across voting, immigration, benefits, and civic participation.

USAGov serves as the U.S. government's central portal for citizens and immigrants, providing authoritative guidance on interactions with agencies including USCIS, IRS, VA, Social Security Administration, and Department of Justice. The site offers comprehensive resources in both English and Spanish for navigating government processes, from voter registration and Green Card applications to disaster assistance and veterans benefits.

## Key Topics

- Voter registration and election processes
- Immigration (Green Card, visas, asylum, USCIS)
- Veterans benefits and services (VA, DOL)
- Disaster assistance and emergency aid
- Social Security and retirement planning
- IRS tax filing and compliance
- Legal name changes and documentation
- Civic participation and contacting elected officials
- State-specific requirements and deadlines
- Federal holidays and U.S. symbols
- Crime victim support (Department of Justice)
- Marriage, divorce, and court orders
- Bilingual services (English and Spanish)

## Voting and Civic Participation

- [Find and contact elected officials](https://www.usa.gov/elected-officials): Contact tool for Congress, president, state & local officials
- [Voter registration deadlines](https://www.usa.gov/voter-registration-deadlines): State-by-state voter registration deadlines via vote.gov
- [Electoral College](https://www.usa.gov/electoral-college): Electoral College presidential election process & elector system
- [Averigüe si está registrado para votar](https://www.usa.gov/es/averigue-si-esta-registrado-para-votar): Check voter registration status via Vote.gov (Spanish)

## Immigration and Visas

- [How to get a Green Card](https://www.usa.gov/how-to-get-green-card): Permanent Resident Card application via adjustment or consular process
- [Refugees and asylum](https://www.usa.gov/refugee-and-asylum): U.S. refugee & asylum application process via embassies
- [Get a student visa to study in the U.S.](https://www.usa.gov/student-visa): F-1, M-1, J-1 student visa types & SEVP application process
- [Immigrant visa to work in the U.S.](https://www.usa.gov/immigrant-work-visa): Employment-based immigrant visa & green card via USCIS & DOL
- [Renounce or lose your citizenship](https://www.usa.gov/renounce-lose-citizenship): U.S. citizenship renunciation & denaturalization process via embassy

## Disaster Assistance and Emergency Support

- [Desastres y emergencias](https://www.usa.gov/es/desastres-emergencias): D-SNAP disaster assistance, housing & emergency aid (Spanish)
- [Obtenga ayuda financiera para pagar o reparar su casa después de un desastre natural](https://www.usa.gov/es/ayuda-hipoteca-desastre): FHA & SBA disaster mortgage assistance & home repair loans (Spanish)
- [Find support if you experienced a crime](https://www.usa.gov/crime-victim-support): DOJ victim services, compensation, counseling & hotlines by state

## Veterans Services and Benefits

- [Veterans burial and survivor benefits](https://www.usa.gov/burial-survivor-benefits): VA military burial, national cemetery & survivor benefits for veterans
- [Obtenga un pago por cuidar a un familiar](https://www.usa.gov/es/paga-cuidador-de-un-familiar): Medicaid CDPAP & veteran caregiver compensation programs (Spanish)

## Legal and Personal Documentation

- [How to change your name and what government agencies to notify](https://www.usa.gov/name-change): Legal name change process & updating SSA, IRS, and other agencies
- [How to file a federal tax return if you live outside the U.S.](https://www.usa.gov/file-taxes-outside-us): IRS expat tax filing for U.S. citizens & Green Card holders abroad
- [Herramientas para planificar la jubilación en Estados Unidos](https://www.usa.gov/es/herramientas-planear-jubilacion): Social Security retirement planning tools & calculators (Spanish)

## U.S. Facts and Symbols

- [U.S. facts and figures](https://www.usa.gov/facts-figures): U.S. holidays, flag, presidents, census data & Constitution reference
- [Aprenda sobre la bandera de Estados Unidos y otros símbolos](https://www.usa.gov/es/bandera-simbolos-estados-unidos): U.S. flag, symbols, Pledge of Allegiance info (Spanish)
- [Día de Año Nuevo](https://www.usa.gov/es/ano-nuevo): New Year's Day federal holiday info (Spanish) - Times Square tradition
